sections.heading: The tower
lines: Pick a tower in the Hall and open a lobby. A tower is a climb of floors; each floor is a battle against wild opponents, then a boss.
Floors 5 and 10 are milestones with bigger bosses. Some towers keep going into harder cycles (Ascension).

sections.heading: Getting in
lines: You need a Tower Key and a registered party of up to six Pokemon. Invite friends in the lobby and everyone readies up.
In Rental Draft mode you borrow a team instead, and your own Pokemon stay safe.

sections.heading: Between floors
lines: At the intermission the team drafts a modifier (a harder floor for better rewards), can visit the vendor to heal or buy, and sometimes meets a room: Rest, Shrine, Forge, Library, Vault or Mystic Pool.
Relics from bosses and rooms help for the rest of the run (up to six). The team votes to keep climbing or cash out.

sections.heading: Rewards
lines: Rewards are banked at milestone floors, when you cash out and when you finish the tower. Cashing out keeps what is banked and ends the run.

sections.heading: Daily and weekly trials
lines: Each day and week has its own tower, built from a mix of regions with its own rules. Everyone gets the same one.
You get one scored attempt on each trial; later runs are practice. Daily trials build a streak, and weekly trials add a rule for the whole week.

sections.heading: Mastery and your name
lines: Achievements in a tower raise your mastery level there. The icon and number beside your name show your best tower.
Pick which tower shows with /tower badge <tower>, or /tower badge off to hide it.

sections.heading: Useful commands
lines: /tower opens the Hall. /tower help shows this guide in chat. /tower trial shows today's trials. /tower report <text> tells us about a problem or an idea.
